references.text: Background for the plague: Israel's sin with Baal-Peor and the Moabite women that led to God's wrath
Moses refers back to the incident at Peor where the plague struck the Lord's assembly
Moses reminds the people that the Lord destroyed all who followed Baal-Peor
Joshua mentions the sin at Peor as a warning to Israel
The psalm describes how Israel bound themselves to Baal-Peor and the plague broke out, but Phinehas intervened
Hosea refers to Israel dedicating themselves to Baal-Peor and becoming detestable
Paul warns the Corinthians against sexual immorality and notes that 23,000 fell in one day, a reference to the incident at Peor
